{"command":"create","path":"/workspace/job_description.md","file_text":"# Software Development Engineer - New Grads

The Agent Company is an innovative software firm specializing in distributed systems, database technologies, and artificial intelligence. Our core business includes developing and maintaining high-performance distributed graph databases, streaming databases, and providing advanced AI solutions.

At The Agent Company, we hire the best minds in technology to innovate and build on behalf of our customers. Our Software Development Engineers (SDEs) use cutting-edge technology to solve complex problems and get to see the impact of their work first-hand. The challenges SDEs solve for at The Agent Company are big and impact millions of customers, sellers, and products around the world. With a dedicated mentor and supportive team, you'll onboard quickly and start contributing to impactful projects soon after starting here at The Agent Company!

## Key Responsibilities:
- Ship production-quality code early and often across services that power distributed databases, streaming systems, and AI features.
- Design, implement, test, and operate services with high availability, low latency, and strict SLAs under real-world load.
- Profile and optimize performance at every layer (algorithmic complexity, memory, CPU, IO, networking) with measurable improvements.
- Write robust tests (unit, integration, property, and load) and maintain CI/CD pipelines to keep master green.
- Participate in rigorous design and code reviews; hold a high bar for correctness, security, and maintainability.
- Own features end-to-end from ambiguous problem statement to production rollout, observability, and iteration.
- Contribute to on-call rotations, rapidly triage incidents, and drive root-cause analyses to completion.
- Document decisions and systems clearly; communicate trade-offs and defend them with data.

## Minimum Requirements:
- BS or MS in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, or related field.
- Strong CS fundamentals: data structures, algorithms, operating systems, networking, and distributed systems.
- Proficiency in at least one of: Go, Rust, C++, Java, or Python; willingness to learn the right tool for the job.
- Working knowledge of Linux, containers, Git, testing methodologies, and CI/CD.
- Ability to break down ambiguous problems, manage intense priorities, and deliver under tight deadlines.
- Excellent written and verbal communication.

## Preferred Qualifications:
- Internship or substantial project experience in distributed systems, databases, streaming, or large-scale backend services.
- Experience with Kubernetes, Docker, and a major cloud (AWS/GCP/Azure).
- Familiarity with Kafka, Flink/Spark, vector/graph databases, and consensus protocols (Raft/Paxos/ZAB).
- Hands-on with observability stacks (Prometheus/Grafana/ELK/OpenTelemetry) and performance profiling.
- Security-minded development and familiarity with threat modeling.

# Software Development Engineer - New Grads

The Agent Company is an innovative software firm specializing in distributed systems, database technologies, and artificial intelligence. Our core business includes developing and maintaining high-performance distributed graph databases, streaming databases, and providing advanced AI solutions.

At The Agent Company, we hire the best minds in technology to innovate and build on behalf of our customers. Our Software Development Engineers (SDEs) use cutting-edge technology to solve complex problems and get to see the impact of their work first-hand. The challenges SDEs solve for at The Agent Company are big and impact millions of customers, sellers, and products around the world. With a dedicated mentor and supportive team, you'll onboard quickly and start contributing to impactful projects soon after starting here at The Agent Company!

## Key Responsibilities:
- Ship production-quality code early and often across services that power distributed databases, streaming systems, and AI features.
- Design, implement, test, and operate services with high availability, low latency, and strict SLAs under real-world load.
- Profile and optimize performance at every layer (algorithmic complexity, memory, CPU, IO, networking) with measurable improvements.
- Write robust tests (unit, integration, property, and load) and maintain CI/CD pipelines to keep master green.
- Participate in rigorous design and code reviews; hold a high bar for correctness, security, and maintainability.
- Own features end-to-end from ambiguous problem statement to production rollout, observability, and iteration.
- Contribute to on-call rotations, rapidly triage incidents, and drive root-cause analyses to completion.
- Document decisions and systems clearly; communicate trade-offs and defend them with data.

## Minimum Requirements:
- BS or MS in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, or related field.
- Strong CS fundamentals: data structures, algorithms, operating systems, networking, and distributed systems.
- Proficiency in at least one of: Go, Rust, C++, Java, or Python; willingness to learn the right tool for the job.
- Working knowledge of Linux, containers, Git, testing methodologies, and CI/CD.
- Ability to break down ambiguous problems, manage intense priorities, and deliver under tight deadlines.
- Excellent written and verbal communication.

## Preferred Qualifications:
- Internship or substantial project experience in distributed systems, databases, streaming, or large-scale backend services.
- Experience with Kubernetes, Docker, and a major cloud (AWS/GCP/Azure).
- Familiarity with Kafka, Flink/Spark, vector/graph databases, and consensus protocols (Raft/Paxos/ZAB).
- Hands-on with observability stacks (Prometheus/Grafana/ELK/OpenTelemetry) and performance profiling.
- Security-minded development and familiarity with threat modeling.

We are hiring Software Engineer - New Grads across multiple offices. Please apply for the single location that you're the most interested in, and we will discuss more with you as you move through the process. We can only consider one application in 30 days.

## What to Expect
- A fast-paced, high-ownership environment with a steep learning curve, rigorous quality standards, and continuous feedback.
- Frequent design/code reviews and production responsibilities early in your tenure.
- Clear, measurable goals; high-performing teams; and a culture that rewards resilience and bias for action.

## Salary Range
Competitive and location-based; includes base salary, equity, and benefits. Exact compensation is determined by location and experience and will be shared early in the process.

## Our Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion
At The Agent Company, we are committed to fostering a diverse and inclusive culture where everyone can excel. We take great care to ensure that our hiring practices are inclusive and meet equal employment opportunity standards. Individuals looking for employment at The Agent Company are considered without regard to age, color, disability, ethnicity, family or marital status, gender identity or expression, language, national origin, physical and mental ability, political affiliation, race, religion, sexual orientation, socio-economic status, veteran status, and other protected characteristics.

focus('1202')
clear('1202')
fill('1202', '# Software Development Engineer - New Grads

The Agent Company is an innovative software firm specializing in distributed systems, database technologies, and artificial intelligence. Our core business includes developing and maintaining high-performance distributed graph databases, streaming databases, and providing advanced AI solutions.

At The Agent Company, we hire the best minds in technology to innovate and build on behalf of our customers. Our Software Development Engineers (SDEs) use cutting-edge technology to solve complex problems and get to see the impact of their work first-hand. The challenges SDEs solve for at The Agent Company are big and impact millions of customers, sellers, and products around the world. With a dedicated mentor and supportive team, you'll onboard quickly and start contributing to impactful projects soon after starting here at The Agent Company!

## Key Responsibilities:

focus('1202')

fill('1202', '# Software Development Engineer - New Grads

The Agent Company is an innovative software firm specializing in distributed systems, database technologies, and artificial intelligence. Our core business includes developing and maintaining high-performance distributed graph databases, streaming databases, and providing advanced AI solutions.

At The Agent Company, we hire the best minds in technology to innovate and build on behalf of our customers. Our Software Development Engineers (SDEs) use cutting-edge technology to solve complex problems and get to see the impact of their work first-hand. The challenges SDEs solve for at The Agent Company are big and impact millions of customers, sellers, and products around the world. With a dedicated mentor and supportive team, you'll onboard quickly and start contributing to impactful projects soon after starting here at The Agent Company!

## Key Responsibilities:
- Ship production-quality code early and often across services that power distributed databases, streaming systems, and AI features.
- Design, implement, test, and operate services with high availability, low latency, and strict SLAs under real-world load.
- Profile and optimize performance at every layer (algorithmic complexity, memory, CPU, IO, networking) with measurable improvements.
- Write robust tests (unit, integration, property, and load) and maintain CI/CD pipelines to keep master green.
- Participate in rigorous design and code reviews; hold a high bar for correctness, security, and maintainability.
- Own features end-to-end from ambiguous problem statement to production rollout, observability, and iteration.
- Contribute to on-call rotations, rapidly triage incidents, and drive root-cause analyses to completion.
- Document decisions and systems clearly; communicate trade-offs and defend them with data.

## Minimum Requirements:
- BS or MS in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, or related field.
- Strong CS fundamentals: data structures, algorithms, operating systems, networking, and distributed systems.
- Proficiency in at least one of: Go, Rust, C++, Java, or Python; willingness to learn the right tool for the job.
- Working knowledge of Linux, containers, Git, testing methodologies, and CI/CD.
- Ability to break down ambiguous problems, manage intense priorities, and deliver under tight deadlines.
- Excellent written and verbal communication.

## Preferred Qualifications:
- Internship or substantial project experience in distributed systems, databases, streaming, or large-scale backend services.
- Experience with Kubernetes, Docker, and a major cloud (AWS/GCP/Azure).
- Familiarity with Kafka, Flink/Spark, vector/graph databases, and consensus protocols (Raft/Paxos/ZAB).
- Hands-on with observability stacks (Prometheus/Grafana/ELK/OpenTelemetry) and performance profiling.
- Security-minded development and familiarity with threat modeling.

We are hiring Software Engineer - New Grads across multiple offices. Please apply for the single location that you're the most interested in, and we will discuss more with you as you move through the process. We can only consider one application in 30 days.

## What to Expect
- A fast-paced, high-ownership environment with a steep learning curve, rigorous quality standards, and continuous feedback.
- Frequent design/code reviews and production responsibilities early in your tenure.
- Clear, measurable goals; high-performing teams; and a culture that rewards resilience and bias for action.

## Salary Range
Competitive and location-based; includes base salary, equity, and benefits. Exact compensation is determined by location and experience and will be shared early in the process.

## Our Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion
At The Agent Company, we are committed to fostering a diverse and inclusive culture where everyone can excel. We take great care to ensure that our hiring practices are inclusive and meet equal employment opportunity standards. Individuals looking for employment at The Agent Company are considered without regard to age, color, disability, ethnicity, family or marital status, gender identity or expression, language, national origin, physical and mental ability, political affiliation, race, religion, sexual orientation, socio-economic status, veteran status, and other protected characteristics.')
# Save
click('1199')
noop(1500)

click('334')
noop(1500)
```

focus('1202')
clear('1202')
fill('1202', '# Software Development Engineer - New Grads

The Agent Company is an innovative software firm specializing in distributed systems, database technologies, and artificial intelligence. Our core business includes developing and maintaining high-performance distributed graph databases, streaming databases, and providing advanced AI solutions.

At The Agent Company, we hire the best minds in technology to innovate and build on behalf of our customers. Our Software Development Engineers (SDEs) use cutting-edge technology to solve complex problems and get to see the impact of their work first-hand. The challenges SDEs solve for at The Agent Company are big and impact millions of customers, sellers, and products around the world. With a dedicated mentor and supportive team, you'll onboard quickly and start contributing to impactful projects soon after starting here at The Agent Company!

## Key Responsibilities:
- Ship production-quality code early and often across services that power distributed databases, streaming systems, and AI features.
- Design, implement, test, and operate services with high availability, low latency, and strict SLAs under real-world load.
- Profile and optimize performance at every layer (algorithmic complexity, memory, CPU, IO, networking) with measurable improvements.
- Write robust tests (unit, integration, property, and load) and maintain CI/CD pipelines to keep master green.
- Participate in rigorous design and code reviews; hold a high bar for correctness, security, and maintainability.
- Own features end-to-end from ambiguous problem statement to production rollout, observability, and iteration.
- Contribute to on-call rotations, rapidly triage incidents, and drive root-cause analyses to completion.
- Document decisions and systems clearly; communicate trade-offs and defend them with data.

## Minimum Requirements:
- BS or MS in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, or related field.
- Strong CS fundamentals: data structures, algorithms, operating systems, networking, and distributed systems.
- Proficiency in at least one of: Go, Rust, C++, Java, or Python; willingness to learn the right tool for the job.
- Working knowledge of Linux, containers, Git, testing methodologies, and CI/CD.
- Ability to break down ambiguous problems, manage intense priorities, and deliver under tight deadlines.
- Excellent written and verbal communication.

## Preferred Qualifications:
- Internship or substantial project experience in distributed systems, databases, streaming, or large-scale backend services.
- Experience with Kubernetes, Docker, and a major cloud (AWS/GCP/Azure).
- Familiarity with Kafka, Flink/Spark, vector/graph databases, and consensus protocols (Raft/Paxos/ZAB).
- Hands-on with observability stacks (Prometheus/Grafana/ELK/OpenTelemetry) and performance profiling.
- Security-minded development and familiarity with threat modeling.

We are hiring Software Engineer - New Grads across multiple offices. Please apply for the single location that you're the most interested in, and we will discuss more with you as you move through the process. We can only consider one application in 30 days.

## What to Expect
- A fast-paced, high-ownership environment with a steep learning curve, rigorous quality standards, and continuous feedback.
- Frequent design/code reviews and production responsibilities early in your tenure.
- Clear, measurable goals; high-performing teams; and a culture that rewards resilience and bias for action.

## Company Vision
To become a global leader in distributed systems and artificial intelligence, solving complex data processing and analysis challenges through innovative technologies.

## Company Mission
To provide businesses and developers with the most advanced, efficient, and user-friendly data processing and AI tools, driving technological innovation and maximizing the value of data.

## Salary Range
Competitive and location-based; includes base salary, equity, and benefits. Exact compensation is determined by location and experience and will be shared early in the process.

## Our Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion
At The Agent Company, we are committed to fostering a diverse and inclusive culture where everyone can excel. We take great care to ensure that our hiring practices are inclusive and meet equal employment opportunity standards. Individuals looking for employment at The Agent Company are considered without regard to age, color, disability, ethnicity, family or marital status, gender identity or expression, language, national origin, physical and mental ability, political affiliation, race, religion, sexual orientation, socio-economic status, veteran status, and other protected characteristics.')

willingness to learn the right tool for the job.\n- Working knowledge of Linux, containers, Git, testing methodologies, and CI/CD.\n- Ability to break down ambiguous problems, manage intense priorities, and deliver under tight deadlines.\n- Excellent written and verbal communication.\n\n## Preferred Qualifications:\n- Internship or substantial project experience in distributed systems, databases, streaming, or large-scale backend services.\n- Experience with Kubernetes, Docker, and a major cloud (AWS/GCP/Azure).\n- Familiarity with Kafka, Flink/Spark, vector/graph databases, and consensus protocols (Raft/Paxos/ZAB).\n- Hands-on with observability stacks (Prometheus/Grafana/ELK/OpenTelemetry) and performance profiling.\n- Security-minded development and familiarity with threat modeling.\n\nWe are hiring Software Engineer - New Grads across multiple offices. Please apply for the single location that you\'re the most interested in, and we will discuss more with you as you move through the process. We can only consider one application in 30 days.\n\n## What to Expect\n- A fast-paced, high-ownership environment with a steep learning curve, rigorous quality standards, and continuous feedback.\n- Frequent design/code reviews and production responsibilities early in your tenure.\n- Clear, measurable goals; high-performing teams; and a culture that rewards resilience and bias for action.\n\n## Company Vision\nTo become a global leader in distributed systems and artificial intelligence, solving complex data processing and analysis challenges through innovative technologies.\n\n## Company Mission\nTo provide businesses and developers with the most advanced, efficient, and user-friendly data processing and AI tools, driving technological innovation and maximizing the value of data.\n\n## Salary Range\nCompetitive and location-based; includes base salary, equity, and benefits. Exact compensation is determined by location and experience and will be shared early in the process.\n\n## Our Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion\nAt The Agent Company, we are committed to fostering a diverse and inclusive culture where everyone can excel. We take great care to ensure that our hiring practices are inclusive and meet equal employment opportunity standards. Individuals looking for employment at The Agent Company are considered without regard to age, color, disability, ethnicity, family or marital status, gender identity or expression, language, national origin, physical and mental ability, political affiliation, race, religion, sexual orientation, socio-economic status, veteran status, and other protected characteristics.')
